description: Election Commission - Notify the name of S. Abygunawardena as a member of the  Maharagama Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Maharagama Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the declaration of an elected member to fill a council seat that became vacant due to a procedural failure (not taking an oath). This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections, making it a clear example of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
